goal: Implement slugify(text) in textkit/slug.py and unittest tests in tests/test_slug.py. Standard library only. Normalize with Unicode NFKD then ASCII encode ignoring non-ASCII, lowercase, replace each run of characters outside a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen, strip leading/trailing hyphens. Add a docstring describing behavior. Use direct module imports matching existing conventions. Do not edit other files.
acceptance_criteria: Empty, whitespace-only, punctuation-only and non-ASCII-only input produce empty string
Tests use direct assertEqual assertions with explicit expected strings and cover digits, underscores, repeated hyphens, tabs/newlines and idempotence
